label: Обёртка письма (IQ)
description: Наружная часть письма: голова со стилями проекта, preheader, контейнер 580px, footer, gmail-fix. Внутрь (include blocks/header) стекаются section-блоки.
pug:
doctype PUBLIC "-//W3C//DTD XHTML 1.0 Strict//EN" "http://www.w3.org/TR/xhtml1/DTD/xhtml1-strict.dtd"
html(xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml")

    include ../../../../vendor/helpers/mixins
    include ../../../../vendor/helpers/head
    <u></u>
    body.body(style="background-color:{{ background_color }}")
        include helpers/preheader
        table.body(style="background-color:{{ background_color }}")
            tr
                td(align="center", valign="top" style="background-color:{{ background_color }}").center.bg-col
                    center
                        table.container
                            tr
                                td.pt0.iq-outer-wrapper--plr10a
                                    //- {{ SECTION_BLOCKS }}
                                    include blocks/header
                                    include helpers/footer

        //Gmail App Fix
        include ../../../../vendor/helpers/gmail-fix
note: Голова (стили проекта) подключается через include vendor/helpers/head. Контентные section-блоки идут в include blocks/header.
